By way of filing the instant Criminal Misc. Petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. petitioner has challenged the order dated 27.01.2016 passed by the learned Additional District Judge No.3,
Bikaner and order dated 16.01.2015 passed by the the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (PC & PNDT) Cases, Bikaner.
2.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (PC & PNDT) Cases, Bikaner
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Vide order dated 16.01.2015, the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate (PC & PNDT)
Cases, Bikaner passed in Criminal Case No.6/2015 wherein after hearing the counsel for the petitioner, the learned trial Judge ordered to take cognizance of offence under Section 420 of the IPC only against Parmeshwar Lal and his prayer for impleading Mal Chand Patwari, Manmohan Poonam Chand vs State And Ors.

entities.text:

Cases, Bikaner
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Mal Chand Patwari, Manmohan Poonam Chand vs State And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: : RJ-JD:23084] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-681/2016] Chandak and his wife Smt. Kamla Chandak as accused

3. Against the order aforesaid, the petitioner preferred a revision petition No.23/2015 (38/2015)
before the learned Additional Sessions Judge No.3, Bikaner wherein same prayer for impleading three above named persons other than Parmeshwar Lal was made.
Both the parties were heard at length and vide order dated 27.01.2016, the learned Court of revision has declined to interfere in the matter.

4. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State and perused the orders passed by the learned Courts below.
5.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and after examining the legality,
correctness as well as propriety of the orders passed by both the Courts below, this Court is of the view that when once the case has prudently been examined by the learned Appellate Court then the same does not require any interference by this Court and the present Misc. Petition is nothing but a second revision petition in disguise of a criminal Misc. petition, which is barred by law.
6.
Accordingly, there is no force in the instant Misc. Petition, the same is hereby dismissed.

(FARJAND ALI),J 195-Mamta/-
